narration: In existing methods, the first stage feeds the input image into a diffusion model to generate a reconstructed image.
A brick wall separates the stages without interaction, where the second stage computes the absolute difference reconstruction error to classify real versus generated images.
In our proposed method, the input image is processed through the FMRE module to generate an aligned pseudo sample alongside the original image.
Both streams pass jointly through the diffusion model, producing reconstructions and corresponding residual maps via absolute difference operations.
The residuals are concatenated and fed into the classifier with end-to-end training, achieving better alignment between diffusion reconstruction and classification.
